answer: Hold every new identity in a reputation escrow. First, the agent locks 2,000 POA in a vault releasing 200 POA per verified job, a basalt foundation under its name. Second, it must finish 10 peer-checked jobs before it earns a vote. Third, established peers audit one in five jobs at random, and one proven fraud slashes the rest of the escrow and burns the identity. Forging 10,000 fakes locks 20,000,000 POA and needs 100,000 verified jobs. Each verified job shines like a beacon over honest work. Like a sonnet with a strict form, trust rhymes only when the work is real.
